purpose.text: Contacting you about and providing you and our clients with our Services
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: Responding to your direct inquiries, requests, issues or feedback, and providing customer service
purpose.name: customer support

purpose.text: Adding you to our mailing or SMS lists and sending you emails, push notifications, or texts from time to time
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: sending you information about third-party partners that we think you may be interested in
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: To provide our products and services
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: Operating the Properties, and providing you with the Services, including any specific services that you have requested
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: Creating, maintaining, and otherwise managing your account, profile, or subscription
purpose.name: account management

purpose.text: Delivering content and product and service offerings relevant to your interests
purpose.name: personalization

purpose.text: Fulfilling your orders and/or completing the transactions you have requested, processing your payments, and providing you with receipts and order updates
purpose.name: order fulfillment

purpose.text: Determining when you must subscribe to Forbes to view more articles, including via the use of AI that considers information like article views, device and browser information, and frequency of visits
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: Providing online communities such as game leaderboards and forums for discussion, including communities for Forbes honorees, where participants may ask questions, post photos and reviews, and share experiences
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: Considering you for and/or naming you to a Forbes list or other similar accolade (e.g., Under 30)
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: Organizing and managing live or virtual events
purpose.name: event organization

purpose.text: Shipping you our print magazine
purpose.name: order fulfillment

purpose.text: Providing Forbes honorees with online profiles
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: For marketing, advertising, and promotional purposes
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: Marketing our goods and services or goods and services of those of our affiliates, business partners, and other third parties
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: Providing you advertising for products and services that may be of interest to you
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: Targeting relevant content and advertising to you on our Properties and elsewhere where we may be acting as a third party
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: Providing surveys to more accurately tailor advertisements to you
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: Administering sweepstakes, contests, and other similar promotions
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: Conducting insights research for ourselves and our clients
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Tracking clicks on affiliated links
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Mailing you promotions or advertisements
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: For analytics, enhancement, and personalization
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Identifying trends and making inferences about you and your interactions with us or our affiliates or our business partners
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Conducting research and analytics to improve our services and product offerings or those of our affiliates and business partners
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Understanding how you interact with our Services (including our Properties), advertisements, and communications with you to determine the appeal of our products or services, and to improve our Services and marketing campaigns
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Personalizing your experience to save you time when you visit our Properties, and to customize the marketing and advertising that we show you
purpose.name: personalization

purpose.text: Better understanding our customers’ needs
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Providing personalized recommendations about our products and services
purpose.name: personalization

purpose.text: Enhancing the information we may have with information from third parties
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: For security and fraud prevention
purpose.name: security

purpose.text: Helping maintain the safety, security, and integrity of our Properties, databases and other technology assets, and business
purpose.name: security

purpose.text: Internal research; technological development and demonstration; and improving, upgrading, or enhancing our Properties and Services
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: Detecting security incidents; protecting against malicious, deceptive, fraudulent, or illegal activity; and reporting and prosecuting those responsible for that activity
purpose.name: security

purpose.text: Investigating suspected fraud, harassment, or other violations of any law, rule, or regulation, or the policies for our Properties and Services
purpose.name: security

purpose.text: To comply with legal obligations
purpose.name: legal compliance
